elements.note: One full-frame illustration per beat of the story (here a scared child in front of an old house at dusk), slowly zooming in or out. The character's face sits just below the middle, under the captions.

note: Storytelling format: the voiceover tells the story, every beat gets its own picture with a slow Ken Burns move, and the only text is the captions, one big word at a time in the centre (white, bold italic, dark shadow). No headlines, no layout to read: the picture and the voice carry it.
